axes: glTF +Y up, 1 unit = 1 m. Creature faces glTF +Z (Blender -Y), ground contact at y = 0; the engine turns it with yaw(angle) * rot_y(PI).
design: a forward-leaning sheaf of kindling tied by two obsidian collars, flaring into a pale ash torch head around a teal Unmade fire, a lit fuse with a big white-teal spark; two obsidian stilt legs, one stick arm trailing back, one snapped stump

bones.body: the sheaf (sticks, torch head, collars, core, shoulder shards) and both arms; scale = the swell
bones.head: the torch-head fire (pivot at the neck collar's centre; scale = the fire blazing and throbbing)
bones.tail: the fuse + spark (pivot at the fuse's root; scale = the fuse burning down)

clip_map.windup: PRIMED begins: skid, the fire catches and flares, swell, the fuse burns down; ends on primed@loop's first frame
clip_map.primed@loop: PRIMED: loop it after windup for the rest of the fuse - the fire blazes about 2 x and throbs three times a second (the brightest swarm on screen)
clip_map.attack: the detonation when the fuse runs out (play on the despawn; the blast is the engine's VFX at fx_core)
clip_map.death: shot down before it blows: stagger, sputtering swell, a small burst

extra_sockets.fx_fuse: on tail: the spark at the fuse tip (moves down as the fuse burns in windup)

move_note: rigid-group sprint: play move@loop at speed / move_cycle_m cycles per second (the Bomber runs at 1.1 x 4.6 m/s -> about 5.6 cycles/s, 11 strides a second: the frantic RUSH)
